Arduino Visual Lab - Classroom Guide


Educational wiring + code simulator for students, teachers, and makers. Fast feedback beats cycle-accurate AVR claims.


Content pack: 15 modules  |  20 examples  |  16 lessons  |  15 challenges  |  20 quiz questions  |  6 exams


Students


    

  1. Open a Lesson or Module, or start from the default Blink circuit.
    2. 

  2. Drag pin -> pin to wire. Colors: red~VCC, black~GND, others~signal.
    3. 

  3. Write Arduino-style code in the Code tab. Press Run (Ctrl+Enter).
    4. 

  4. Use Serial dock to print numbers / send characters.
    5. 

  5. Try Challenges for auto-checked goals.
    6. 

  6. Submit exports README + sketch.ino + project.json for your teacher.
    7. 



Teachers


    

  1. Enable Teacher mode to load lesson skeletons without full solutions.
    2. 

  2. Assign a Lesson goal (overlay) or a Challenge.
    3. 

  3. Collect Submit packs or Share codes from students.
    4. 

  4. Use Warnings to discuss common wiring mistakes.
    5. 



Shortcuts


Ctrl+Enter / R Run  |  Esc Stop  |  W Wire  |  C wire color  |  Delete  |  Ctrl+Z/Y Undo/Redo  |  Ctrl+S Save  |  Double-click part = Props  |  Mouse wheel zoom  |  Grade  |  Diag  |  Physics  |  Meter  |  Suggest R  |  HUD


What is simulated well


LED + resistor, button pull-up, pot->ADC/PWM, servo angle, motor spin, Serial I/O, basic ultrasonic/pulseIn, ESP32 WiFi stubs.


Limits


Not a full SPICE/AVR model. Validate timing-critical and advanced bus projects on real hardware or specialized tools.







Example Projects









Supported APIs


pinMode digitalWrite/Read analogWrite/Read delay delayMicroseconds millis micros tone noTone map constrain random Serial.print/println/available/read attachInterrupt


Partial libs: Servo (attach/write), LiquidCrystal (print/setCursor/clear), Wire (I2C stub). PWM dims LEDs & speeds motors. Serial monitor is bidirectional.
